articles.title: Angels interim GM John Mozeliak endorses Kurt Suzuki to return as manager
articles.description: Mozeliak says he “would like” Suzuki to return as manager, but he’s waiting for more guidance from the new ownership group. Mozeliak says he’s been in regular contact with Kevin Demoff, who runs the ...

articles.title: Angels go out swinging (and missing), close season with 100th loss
articles.description: They strike out 12 times in loss to the Mariners securing the first 100-loss season in franchise history, which is a 10-game slide from 2025 when the Angels had a 72-90 record.

articles.title: Angels’ Zach Neto reflects on a season in which he wasn’t himself early
articles.description: Neto, 26, is finishing off his third straight 20/20 season. On the down side, he struck out more than 200 times and played sloppy defense at times. He’s gotten better late in the season.

articles.title: Angels’ bullpen falters against Mariners in 99th loss of season
articles.description: The Angels erase a four-run deficit in the sixth inning, but Mitch Farris allows four runs in the seventh as Seattle pulls away for an 8-4 victory. The teams wrap up the season Sunday in Seattle.

articles.title: Angels slug their way to victory in Seattle
articles.description: Christian Moore hits a three-run homer, Zach Neto has three hits and Wade Meckler has four hits, powering an offense that supports six scoreless innings from Reid Detmers in a 7-5 win. The Angels need ...

articles.title: Angels rally to get a victory for Grayson Rodriguez in his final start
articles.description: Rodriguez gives up four runs in five innings, and the Angels take the lead on a Christian Moore two-run double just in time for him to get credit for the win in a 6-4 victory over the Mariners.

articles.title: Angels reliever Ryan Watson back where he finished 2025 … sort of
articles.description: The right-hander, who the Angels claimed off waivers from Boston last month, pitched extensively at Sacramento’s Sutter Health Park as a Giants minor-leaguer last year. Leaning more on his curveball, ...

articles.title: Tayler Saucedo has been a positive for Angels’ struggling bullpen
articles.description: Saucedo, 33, has not allowed a run in his last 13 games, the longest streak of his career. The Angels bullpen has been one of the worst in the majors, but Saucedo could be a part of the solution next ...

articles.title: Angels give Christian Moore a day to work on adjustments
articles.description: The rookie second baseman sits out Saturday after snapping an 0-for-21 slump, while Moisés Ballesteros continues his September surge and George Klassen is shut down for the season.

articles.title: Angels play sloppy game in loss to Mariners
articles.description: The Angels make two errors and strike out 10 times, including twice with the bases loaded, on their way to a 7-2 loss. It was their most lopsided defeat in more than a month, coming on the heels of ...

articles.title: A season of learning comes to an end for Angels’ Nolan Schanuel
articles.description: Schanuel has been out since Aug. 20 because of a strained intercostal muscle. He played one game of a rehab assignment before feeling more soreness, so the Angels decided on Friday to end his season.

articles.title: Angels’ Wade Meckler continues making a strong impression
articles.description: An Anaheim native, Meckler has hit .292 with a .751 OPS in his first extended opportunity in the major leagues. His next step is improving against lefties.
